name: Level_1 - Task_7
description: Construct a bulk rutile Titanium Dioxide (TiO₂) crystal structure with lattice parameters a = 4.594 Å and c = 2.959 Å and internal oxygen parameter u = 0.305. Expand the structure into a 2 × 2 × 2 supercell. Load the MACE-MP-0 foundation model as an ASE-compatible atomic calculator. Calculate the total potential energy of the TiO₂ supercell using the MACE calculator and determine the energy per TiO₂ formula unit. Next, construct separate isolated Titanium (Ti) and Oxygen (O) atoms, each centered in a cubic cell with side length 10 Å and with periodic boundary conditions disabled in all directions. Calculate the potential energy of each isolated atom using the same MACE calculator. Calculate the cohesive energy per TiO₂ formula unit using the bulk energy per formula unit and the isolated Ti and O atomic energies. Return the cohesive energy as a float value in eV/formula unit. Do not perform any structural optimization or relaxation.
